subject: Kickoff: security scope & procurement path for Paresh Systems evaluation
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Paresh Kumar <paresh.kumar@technica.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: security scope & procurement path for Paresh Systems evaluation

Hi Paresh / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Attendees (on our side): Connor O'Brien (acct exec), Marissa Cole (Solutions), Neha Kapoor (Security lead)
On your side: Paresh Kumar (CTO), Tom Ellis (Head of Procurement) — please correct if I missed anyone.

Recap / open items:
- Business objective: proof-of-concept running Redwood-hosted inference for customer support summaries (target: 1M tokens/month after Q3)
- Decision criteria you called out: latency under 250ms p50, encryption at rest, contractual data residency, and clear unit-costs for token pricing + reserved capacity options
- Procurement timeline you indicated: internal review through end of May, procurement/PO by mid-June if no blockers

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD Wed?):
1) Economic buyer / budget approver name and email (we want to add them to the commercial thread)
2) Security contact who will own the questionnaire and evidence collection (SOC2, network architecture, data retention)
3) Systems in scope for the security review (examples: public web app, internal admin UI, API endpoints, storage buckets)

I attached a short security intake questionnaire (stub) to help the process — please forward to your security/IT owner and return the filled file when convenient.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I will open a HubSpot deal and attach the questionnaire and SOW draft.
- Marissa will prepare a draft SOW and high-level pricing options (hosted vs. dedicated).
- Neha will coordinate a 45-minute security kickoff with your security/IT team to walk the questionnaire and confirm system boundaries.

Proposed times for the kickoff: Wed 5/20 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu 5/21 14:00–14:45 PT. Which works for Ivan / your security lead?

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Paresh_Systems_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (worksheet with 25 items)
From: Paresh Kumar <paresh.kumar@technica.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@technica.ai>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@technica.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security scope & procurement path for Paresh Systems evaluation

Connor —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the questionnaire. Quick answers on the items you requested: 

1) Economic buyer: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@technica.ai> (CFO) — she'll own final signoff on budget.
2) Security contact: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@technica.ai> (platform security) — I’ve cc'd him.
3) Systems we anticipate in-scope:
   - customer-facing web app (web.technica.ai)
   - public API endpoints used by mobile clients
   - internal support tooling (admin.technica.ai)
   - S3-like object storage for uploaded logs (s3.prod.technica.ai)
   - a small set of anonymized customer PII used for summarization (email addresses only, no SSNs)

Timeline: we will review the questionnaire this week. Procurement cadence: internal review complete by 6/2, procurement/contracting by target 6/18. If security raises big gaps we may push.

One clarification for Neha: in the call we discussed both Redwood-hosted and Private VPC options. For initial POC we expect hosted, but we need to confirm encryption-in-transit + at-rest key control; if required we may request Private deployment later in the process.

Ivan — would you be able to join a kickoff on Wed 5/20 10:00 PT? If not, Thu 5/21 14:00 PT should work.

Best,
Paresh
CTO | Paresh Systems (Technica Labs)
paresh.kumar@technica.ai
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Paresh Kumar <paresh.kumar@technica.ai>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@technica.ai>, Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@technica.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: security scope & procurement path for Paresh Systems evaluation

Thanks Paresh — appreciate the quick responses and the named stakeholders. Looping Anjali for budget visibility.

Neha here — quick answers to Ivan's likely questions before the kickoff:
- Hosted option: supports TLS 1.2/1.3 in transit; at-rest encryption using customer-managed keys is available for Redwood Dedicated and via KMS integration for Private. For hosted we offer AWS-managed KMS encryption by default; we can discuss HSM/KMS key control in the kickoff.
- Data handling: by default we do not retain conversational logs beyond configured retention (default 30 days) unless you opt-in for longer retention for evals. We can set retention policy and provide deletion runbooks.
- Systems in scope you listed are fine — we'll treat the support tooling and storage buckets as in-scope for network and IAM review.

I scheduled the security kickoff for Wed, 20 May 2026 10:00–10:45 PT and added Ivan + our security engineer Neha to the invite. Invite attached.

Next actions for Redwood (owners):
- Marissa: prepare SOW draft with two pricing scenarios (hosted / dedicated) and a short appendix describing optional Private deployment migration steps — due Tue 5/26.
- Neha: prepare security evidence packet (SOC2 summary, network diagram template, RBAC matrix) and run the 45-minute kickoff agenda — kickoff Wed 5/20.
- Connor: create HubSpot deal and add Anjali as a watcher; upload questionnaire to the Drive folder.

Connor

Attachments: Kickoff-Agenda.ics; Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.2.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 13:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Paresh Systems — security kickoff notes & asks (prepare pack)

Team —

Recap from the kickoff this morning (45 mins): Ivan, Paresh, Tom, and Anjali observed. High-level: they are comfortable with hosted for POC if we can confirm KMS controls and the retention policy. Action items below — please treat as high priority for the week.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize SOW v0.3 with pricing rows (per-token + reserved capacity), include optional migration path to Private. Deadline: Tue 5/26 EOD. Attach Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf to HubSpot.
- Neha: produce evidence packet: SOC2 executive summary, network diagram showing perimeter/proxy + allowed egress IPs, RBAC matrix, and a short note on retention/deletion flows. Deadline: Mon 5/25 10:00 PT.
- Rishi: draft a concise procurement checklist (PO template, standard SLA exceptions, sample contract redlines) and flag any commercial concessions we should pre-approve for a mid-June close. Deadline: Fri 5/22.

Notes from kickoff:
- Ivan asked about data residency — Paresh prefers AWS-us-east-1 for log locality; we should confirm endpoint region options and explicit region guarantees for hosted.
- They requested an explicit fallback plan (canary to lower-capacity model) if latency SLOs are missed during peak. Add this to SOW as an optional appendix.

I will update HubSpot with the meeting notes and mark next check-in for Mon 5/25.

Connor
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Paresh Systems — security kickoff notes & asks (prepare pack)

Connor —

Got it. I will:
- Finalize SOW v0.3 and attach Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf to the drive folder and HubSpot by Mon morning.
- Add a short appendix on the fallback/canary model and region guarantees for hosted endpoints.
- Include a one-page pricing scenario that shows: POC hosted estimate (tokens/month), 12-mo reserved capacity break-even, and private deployment uplift.

I'll sync with Rishi on the procurement concessions list and with Neha on the network diagram details.

Marissa
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf (draft)
